newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan stocks close lower in busy trade.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan stocks close lower in busy trade.

text.p: Shares on the Caracas Stock Exchange closed lower in strong trade and despite strong interest in certain leading stocks, brokers said.
According to preliminary figures from the exchange, the market's 19-share index slipped 0.40 percent to 6,653.07 as 26 stocks fell, 13 rose and nine closed flat.
Trading in benchmark stock Electricidad de Caracas was particularly strong with interest driven by an expected approval of higher tariffs shortly.
"I see plenty of interest in the market, especially in Electricidad," said Piero Montelli of Interacciones brokerage.
